summary: Retest after iteration_7 fixes. Backend: 43/43 passed; 1 legacy skip (the CL-2026-00086 snapshot test skips while the record is 'aprobata'). Both iteration_7 defects are FIXED. (a) invoice_id drift: a WO with invoice_id in any stored status (noua, diagnosticare, asteapta_oferta, aprobata, in_lucru, asteapta_piese, finalizata, inchisa) is rejected with 400 on POST status inchisa/in_lucru/noua. Its status stays unchanged, it never appears in GET /api/closure-exceptions/work-orders, and closure-review/reopen return 400. (b) The list includes inchisa WOs with invoice_id null or empty string and excludes any with an invoice_id. Unbilled WOs from all 7 operational statuses, including ones with an approved quote, close without QC. They are listed with pre_closure_status. Aprobare removes the row and the WO stays inchisa. Redeschidere comandă restores the previous status (e.g. asteapta_piese, aprobata, noua, plus a legacy history fallback) and removes the row. Fiscal invoice gate: 400 with no quote or with a rejected/draft/sent/superseded quote, 400 without QC, 400 when not finalizata. It accepts generated quote -> approved -> QC passed -> finalizata -> 200, and the WO then becomes facturata and immutable. UI on /closure-review: the title is 'Verificare închideri nefacturate'. Each TEST row has a link with href=/work-orders/{id} plus 'Aprobare' and 'Redeschidere comandă' buttons. An in_lucru WO, a facturata WO and an inchisa WO with invoice_id (drift) are NOT listed. Clicking Aprobare removes the row (DB: closure_review aprobat, status inchisa). Clicking Redeschidere removes the row and the WO shows ÎN LUCRU with a status selector. Facturata, approved-inchisa and drift-inchisa WOs show no status selector. Real CL-2026-00086 and CL-2026-00083 are untouched (both 'aprobata', no invoice_id); CL-00086 is correctly absent from the list.

issues: Nav label is still 'Verificare închideri' while page title is 'Verificare închideri nefacturate' (cosmetic, optional).

Diagnostic & alocare panel (constatare textarea, elevator, excepție deviz, mecanici checkboxes) still looks editable on locked orders; consider disabling for clarity (not verified whether backend rejects these edits).
